name: Genting Malaysia Berhad
overview: 2026年，Genting Malaysia Berhad 完成了两家休眠子公司的自愿清算（GMM Limited 和 Genting Alderney Limited），这两家公司均不再作为集团子公司存在。此外，公司寻求股东批准续签及新增经常性关联交易授权，并宣派了2025财年的终期股息。
overview_en: In 2026, Genting Malaysia Berhad completed the members' voluntary liquidation of two dormant subsidiaries (GMM Limited and Genting Alderney Limited), both of which ceased to be subsidiaries of the group. Additionally, the company sought shareholder approval for the renewal and new mandate for recurrent related party transactions, and declared a final dividend for FY2025.

segments.name: 集团 / Group
segments.note: 集团层面完成了两家休眠子公司的清算，并处理了股息宣派及关联交易授权等公司事务。
segments.note_en: At the group level, the liquidation of two dormant subsidiaries was completed, and corporate matters such as dividend declaration and related party transaction mandates were handled.

actions.title: WINDING UP / RECEIVER & MANAGER / RESTRAINING ORDER / SPECIAL ADMINISTRATOR
actions.text: GMM Limited 的注册状态于2026年9月4日被记录为“已注销”，该公司不再作为集团子公司存在。
actions.text_en: The registration status of GMM Limited was recorded as 'Cancelled' on 4 September 2026, and it ceased to be a subsidiary of the group.

actions.title: WINDING UP / RECEIVER & MANAGER / RESTRAINING ORDER / SPECIAL ADMINISTRATOR
actions.text: GMM Limited（间接全资休眠子公司）股东决议根据澳门商法典进行自愿清算，相关文件已于2026年8月13日提交。
actions.text_en: Shareholders of GMM Limited (an indirect wholly-owned dormant subsidiary) resolved to dissolve the company under the Macau Commercial Code, with relevant documents submitted on 13 August 2026.

actions.title: WINDING UP / RECEIVER & MANAGER / RESTRAINING ORDER / SPECIAL ADMINISTRATOR
actions.text: Genting Alderney Limited（间接全资休眠子公司）于2026年5月10日解散，不再作为集团子公司存在。
actions.text_en: Genting Alderney Limited (an indirect wholly-owned dormant subsidiary) was dissolved on 10 May 2026 and ceased to be a subsidiary of the group.

actions.title: TRANSACTIONS (CHAPTER 10 OF LISTING REQUIREMENTS) : RECURRENT RELATED PARTY TRANSACTIONS
actions.text: 公司寻求股东批准续签及新增经常性关联交易授权。
actions.text_en: The company sought shareholder approval for the renewal and new mandate for recurrent related party transactions.

actions.title: GENM - Notice of Book Closure
actions.text: 宣派2025财年终期单层股息每股7.0仙，除权日为2026年3月13日，支付日为2026年4月10日。
actions.text_en: Declared a final single-tier dividend of 7.0 sen per ordinary share for FY2025, with ex-date on 13 March 2026 and payment date on 10 April 2026.
